rationale.audience: Adult business users, matching Play audience selection.
rationale.userGeneratedContent: Members create artwork and captions and explicitly publish to Instagram.
rationale.messagingAndChat: Apple includes public posting within this descriptor; MARKOS can publish user-authored content to Instagram.
